# 2. Readings

Last week we discussed how we quantify parameter uncertainty from maximizing the log-likelihood. This week, we'll begin considering the relationship between parameter uncertainty and how we design our experiment by watching the fourth video in [our Youtube playlist](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLzFdSE-D7jUQnbczxdjohRqlBBrrsaFFg) on choice modeling: _Design of Experiments_

**Take notes** as you watch the video. At the end of the video, I ask one practice question - you should answer this question as part of your reflection. You may submit your answer however you wish, e.g. type it in your ``r hw_file`` file and / or hand-write it on paper and take a picture. If you take a picture, save it in your ``r hw_dir`` folder, embed it in ``r hw_file`` (e.g. `![](answers.jpg)`), and commit it along with the rest of your work.

Click [here](../content/slides_doe.pdf) to download the slides in the video as a PDF.

{{< video https://www.youtube.com/embed/xmlGINu0_k8 >}}

Reflect on what you've learned while going through these readings and exercises. Is there anything that jumped out at you? Anything you found particularly interesting or confusing? Write at least a paragraph in your ``r hw_file`` file, and include at least one question. The teaching team will review the questions we get and will try to answer them either in Slack or in class.
